issue.notes:
Discovery from beadrs-bad16411 attempt 3 (2026-10-29), recorded as a proposal — not absorbed into that bead per its red-branch scope rules.

MECHANISM (root-caused end to end):
The cron bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate's release lane runs "python3 /ci-protected-release/bead-release.py plan" BEFORE the gate legs. In candidate mode (pushed commit did not itself bump the version, no docs/releases/vX.Y.Z-secret-scrubbing.json approval present), plan() selects the next patch version, rewrites Cargo.toml + Cargo.lock, and COMMITS a local receipt ("ci: auto-bump version to 0.3.1 (bead-rs)", CI-Release-Source trailer) on top of the pushed revision. The gate legs then run against that bumped tree. tests/plan_tag_consistency.rs::plan_latest_tag_claims_match_repository reads the working-tree Cargo.toml and asserts docs/plan/plan.md's normative "package version X.Y.Z" claim matches it — plan.md cites 0.3.0 (written with the 0.3.0 bump in 92c7b7dc, 2026-10-06), the receipt tree declares 0.3.1, so the test reds at plan_tag_consistency.rs:513.

EVIDENCE:
- Pod run bead-rs-ci-wfhbj on 1bf0bc52 (streamed log /home/coding/.needle/state/gate-bad16411-stream/wfhbj-ci.log): "Compiling bead-rs v0.3.1 (/workspace)" right after the plan step; only failing target = plan_tag_consistency, panic "normative sections 0-8 cite package version 0.3.0, but Cargo.toml declares 0.3.1". fmt/clippy/clippy-msp legs green there; the set-v2 straggler binaries green there (4feba5d5 held).
- Local reproduction with exact pod fidelity (/data/build/bead-rs/sim-bad16411/): clean checkout of 1ddabad5 -> cargo test --test plan_tag_consistency exit=0 (4 passed); after committing the plan()-shaped receipt 763d8d87 bumping 0.3.0->0.3.1 -> exit=101 with the byte-identical panic (phase-A2.log). The pushed tree is self-consistent; only the bumped candidate tree reds.
- iad-ci/bead-rs-ci commit status is failure on every main commit inspected back to fbe2cf7a (2026-10-28 07:08Z); earlier failures were the set-v2 stragglers (owned by beadrs-2ac26b9a, repaired via 4c8fc07f/1cab7678/4feba5d5) — at 1bf0bc52 this version-contract mismatch is the ONLY remaining red in that pipeline.

HAZARD if unresolved: publish_source() pushes the receipt commit to main once the pipeline ever goes green — then main itself carries Cargo.toml 0.3.1 vs plan.md 0.3.0 and EVERY local/canonical gate reds the same test. The pipeline can never go green on its own output as written.

RESOLUTION OPTIONS (need an owner decision — that is why this is a proposal):
1. Repo-side: teach the plan-consistency checker the CI receipt shape (walk back past "ci: auto-bump version to" receipt commits when resolving the declared version in real checkouts) — mirrors the receipt-detection logic plan() itself uses.
2. Pipeline-side (declarative-config k8s/iad-ci): run the gate legs BEFORE the plan/bump step, or have plan() also patch plan.md's normative citation as part of the receipt.
3. Plan-side: restate the claim so it tracks the candidate rather than the source (weakest — weakens the shipped-tree consistency contract the test exists to enforce).

Cross-refs: discovered by beadrs-bad16411 (gate-repair child of beadrs-456dcf82); blocks the iad-ci/bead-rs-ci context from ever going green, which the beadrs-456dcf82/3b100c9b campaign treats as its death-proof record.
issue.title: iad-ci bead-rs-ci candidate bump reds plan_latest_tag_claims_match_repository (release planner vs plan-consistency contract)
